title: Electron 'We're Not Hawking Around' (3x HawkEye 360)

payload_kg.assumption: 3 HawkEye 360 sats ~30 kg each (ASSUMED class value) + Kick Stage dry 40 kg (guide) + kick propellant ~50 kg (ASSUMED)

insertion_alt_km.assumption: S2 inserts Kick Stage into 'low elliptical orbit' (guide); perigee/insertion altitude ASSUMED

apoapsis_alt_km.assumption: apoapsis at 520 km deployment altitude, Kick Stage circularizes

header_notes: Flown: LL2 Success. File ends at S2 cutoff (insertion); Kick Stage circularization not simulated.

cd.assumption: free-molecular flat-plate Cd for the small Kick Stage stack

burns.name: Kick Stage (Curie) circularization

mass_after_drop_kg.derived: Kick Stage + payload stack = launch payload_kg 180 (ASSUMED, see payload_kg) after S2 separation

thrust_N.src: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rocket_Lab_Electron (Curie max thrust 0.12 kN, citing Popular Mechanics 2018)

isp_s.assumption: Curie Isp unpublished; HyperCurie's published 310 s used

burns.basis: Rocket Lab publishes the orbit (520 km, 97 deg) but not Curie burn timing; burn ASSUMED centred on apoapsis, duration solved at 120 N to circularize at 520 km.

deploy.src: modelled at Curie cutoff; Rocket Lab publishes no deploy time. Spacelaunchschedule's update log reports payload separation ~08:04Z (T+~53 min) https://www.spacelaunchschedule.com/launch/electron-were-not-hawking-around-3x-hawkeye-360/
deploy.label: HAWK satellites deploy (modelled)

notes: Third-party payload-separation report ~08:04Z = T+~3180 s is EARLIER than the modelled apoapsis: with the ASSUMED 230 km S2 perigee, apoapsis is ~T+55 min. Treat the deploy time as uncertain by several minutes; insertion perigee is an assumption, not a source.
Inclination is whatever the sim's azimuth gives; Rocket Lab states 97 deg.

deploy.note: Rocket Lab publishes no deploy or Curie burn time (third-party log: separation ~08:04Z), and this untuned energy-mode ascent ends in a ~216 x 590 km (osculating) orbit vs Rocket Lab's 520 km, so a Kick Stage coast would not match sources; deferred until Electron is re-tuned

drag.basis: ASSUMPTION: free-molecular Cd 2.2, frontal area of 1.2 m-diameter upper stage; drag negligible at these altitudes
